title: tiny inconvenient trash can
text: tiny inconvenient trash can. I bought this as a small kitchen can for  food waste. It is so dinky it barely functional as a trash can, impossible to line with plastic liners. It now functions as a mini-poop collector outside for my plastic bag encased dogs poop.
